name: tsc-watch
command: sh -c 'if [ -f tsconfig.json ] || [ -f tsconfig.base.json ]; then npx --no-install tsc -b --watch 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered -E "error TS|Found [1-9][0-9]* error"; else echo "[tsc-watch] no tsconfig in $(pwd); idle"; exec sleep 2147483647; fi'
description: Streams TypeScript build errors (tsc -b --watch). Idle outside a TS repo.

name: dev-errors
description: Surfaces errors from the local dev server. Enable by piping it to a log: `<dev command> | tee .dev.log`.
